title: A conversation reply wears the Frequency email card, and the sender's picture is a round avatar beside the signature

source.ref: owner 2026-10-20 in the project thread, after the live Space send-and-reply pilot (EMAIL-028): the back and forth worked but the email looks horrible; style it with the Frequency email template and put the profile image as a circle to the left of the signature

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: a conversation reply (renderReplyEmail, the batch email renderCoalescedEmail) went out as a bare column with a hairline header and a large square logo above the message, and a plain '-- ' signature, so a member's first Space email did not look like Frequency. THE FIX: lib/comms/email-template.ts wraps the message in the member-kit look (the design's wash page, a raised radius-24 card, Hanken body at 16px, the display face on the Space name, ink from the palette) and renders the signature as a small card: the Space's picture as a 52px circle to the left, the signature lines beside it (the Space name when no signature is set). The logo no longer crowns the card. The plain-text part keeps the RFC 3676 delimiter. Platform mail with no brand gets the same card. The owner's words are the authority for the test change: the old header-logo pin became the avatar pin.

verify.note: PASS 2026-10-20: the template carries the circle avatar and the radius-24 card and no longer sets the 40px header logo; vitest lib/comms green.
